237.summary: The class explores the concept of God's glory as revealed in Ezekiel's vision and through the manna in the wilderness, emphasizing the symbolism of the four faces and the absence of sin. It also ties this to the atonement and the resurrection of Jesus Christ, highlighting the future fulfillment of God's glory filling the earth.

238.summary: The class discusses the revelation of God's glory through Jesus Christ, emphasizing that Jesus is the fullness of the Godhead and the express image of the invisible God. It highlights the importance of recognizing and embodying God's attributes in our lives through our relationship with Christ.
